fields.title: 📖 “An Ilāh in the heaven and an Ilāh on the earth”
fields.body:
🖋️ **Qatādah, Mujāhid, and Ibn al-Jawzī** said:

> ***“He is worshipped in the heaven, and He is worshipped on the earth.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Az-Zukhruf 43:84 is a Tawḥīd verse about Ulūhiyyah, not a proof for Ḥulūl or the claim that Allah is with His essence everywhere.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī, Jāmiʿ al-Bayān, Tafsīr az-Zukhruf 43:84; Ibn al-Jawzī, Zād al-Masīr, Tafsīr az-Zukhruf 43:84.
